name: led-matrix
description: Plays a working animation on an MCP2221 + HT16K33 LED matrix while Claude works, blanks it when Claude is done, and counts down to the reset while the usage limit is hit.

binary.title: claudematrix program
binary.description: Name or path of the claudematrix program. A bare name is looked for in Go's install folders (GOBIN, GOPATH/bin, ~/go/bin), then on PATH.

addr.title: I2C address
addr.description: I2C address of the matrix, 0x70 to 0x77, set with the jumpers on its back (passed to claudematrix as -addr).

rotate.title: Rotation
rotate.description: Turn the display clockwise by 0, 90, 180 or 270 degrees, for a matrix mounted sideways or upside down. Find the value with claudematrix -align.

clockX.title: Countdown shift right
clockX.description: Pixels to move the usage-limit countdown right (negative: left), for a matrix mounted off-centre. Find the value with claudematrix -align.

clockY.title: Countdown shift down
clockY.description: Pixels to move the usage-limit countdown down (negative: up). Find the value with claudematrix -align.

limitFile.title: Usage-limit file
limitFile.description: Where the usage limit's reset time is written for claudematrix's countdown. Empty: ~/.claude/usage-limit.
